name: Lantern DeForest RV Resort
note: Interstate-side overnight park on the north edge of DeForest, a short drive from Madison. In 2026 the bathhouse was under remodel, with the two cabins standing in as restrooms and showers. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site lanterndeforest.com (home, amenities, guest-info/FAQ/regulations, campsites pages read 2026-10-21; operator DeForest Campground, LLC, no membership or application): gravel full-hookup pull-through and back-in RV sites, one unit per site, plus tent sites and cabins; its embedded Newbook engine (read 2026-10-21, 23-ft rig) sells a single night on Tue 10/27/2026, 5/11/2027, 6/15/2027, 7/13/2027 and Sat 7/17/2027 in three RV site types, checkout shows no application or lease; satellite (Esri, read 2026-10-21) shows a fan of ~100 pull-through pads with RVs and no decks/sheds/skirting -> real transient RV park, open year-round (winter camping by phone); price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery 800 m frame read 2026-10-21 (rendered): the RV sites are a fan of gravel loops behind the office south of County Road V, bordered by fields, a storage building and commercial lots; the only water is a pair of stormwater ponds north of the road and highway interchange, ~300 m from the nearest site with the road and businesses between. No water at or in view of any site -> not waterfront (default down)
fees_source: Newbook engine embedded at https://lanterndeforest.com/campsites/ read 2026-10-21, 23-ft rig, 1 night: RV 50/30 Amp FHU Back In $80 (Tue 10/27/2026, 5/11/2027, 6/15/2027, 7/13/2027), $88 Sat 7/17/2027; FHU Pull Thru $85/$93; Premium Patio Pull Thru $99/$108. Checkout for 6/15/2027 pull-through: $85.00 booking + WI and Dane County sales tax only, no resort or booking fee. Extra charge only beyond two adults
flags: Cheapest RV site is $80 a weeknight (back-in full hookup), $88 Saturday; included only because the price gate is lifted.
No standing minimum seen: one night sold on Tuesdays and a July Saturday.
Site says 'We offer winter camping, call the office'; winter nights may be phone-only.
Bathhouse remodel caveat (2026) is in the note; drop it once the remodel is done.
